name: Hardware
author: juansebas7ian
description: One panel for the whole machine: summary with alerts, CPU and cooling (graphs, threads, AIO pump, fans), GPU (NVML live, processes, driver, CUDA), storage (disks, health, firmware, what uses the space, Steam, cleanup), drivers (omarchy-hwcheck, updates, BIOS) and peripherals (Bluetooth with battery and reconnect at boot, wireless batteries, input devices, USB with errors, audio, cameras). One backend process.

barWidget.description: Left = panel · right = btop. Shows the CPU temperature; red on any hardware alert; the number is pending driver updates.
